summary_en: Shinko Shoji will cancel 1,662,909 shares (5.4% of issued shares before cancellation) on October 30, 2026, conditional on shareholder approval of a stock split effective November 2, 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares will total 29,347,657.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Shinko Shoji's Board of Directors resolved on September 7, 2026 to cancel 1,662,909 treasury shares held by the company, representing 5.4% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled for October 30, 2026. The shares to be cancelled consist of 1,401,209 treasury shares owned by the company as of August 25, 2026, plus 259,900 shares and 1,800 restricted shares held by the trustee of the company's executive share grant trust (BBT) and to be acquired by October 30, 2026. Following cancellation, total issued shares will decrease to 29,347,657. The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval at an extraordinary shareholders meeting scheduled for October 9, 2026 of a stock split proposal with an effective date of November 2, 2026.
